decisions.reason: The applicable identity-wide expression priority and visual-tone constraints are already fully recorded by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Broader exploration of the unresolved Hero V does not change the second V's role or its existing prerequisite to derive from the settled Hero V geometry.
The Hero V exploration does not alter the deferred accent's derivation, shared-geometry rule, or specified form.
The source changes Hero V form exploration but leaves the deferred champagne treatment, material qualities, and geometry-first sequence unchanged.
The source concerns exploration of the Hero V as a complete letter and does not modify the deferred full-wordmark rhythm, kerning, or hierarchy requirements.
The fresh Hero V directions do not change the deferred requirements for the remaining custom architectural letterforms.
The integrated whole-letter exploration does not revoke or replace the existing requirement that terminal character arise from structural proportion and remain non-decorative.
The source refines how the Hero V should be explored but does not change the wordmark-led identity, absence of a separate icon, or the opening V's standalone brand role.
